scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The proposed PTMA–chromatin, ribosomal-capacity, RNA-processing, and microtubule-readiness model is biologically defensible in proliferating breast cancer cells. RPL41 as an absolute translational prerequisite and HNRNPA2B1-dependent tubulin production are overstrong interpretations, but they are framed largely as testable extensions rather than established facts.
scores.Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: PTMA-mediated chromatin accessibility is connected to RPL41-associated translation, HNRNPA2B1-mediated RNA handling, and TUBA1C/TUBB4B-associated mitotic execution. The direct transitions from PTMA to HNRNPA2B1-regulated tubulin production and ultimately to Ki-67 remain incompletely resolved. No synthesis ceiling was applied because all four contextual features contribute explicitly to one coherent mechanism.
